newsitem.title: USA: Florida couple plead guilty to keeping slave.
newsitem.headline: Florida couple plead guilty to keeping slave.

text.p: A Miami area couple faced up to five years in prison on Thursday after confessing in court that they had beaten, burned and otherwise abused their domestic servant to keep her enslaved to them, U.S. officials said.

Kishin Kumar Mahtani and his wife, Shashi Gobindram, admitted in court on Wednesday that they had compelled Francesca Ekka, 23, to work excessive hours in their Miami area home with little or no payment for her work, according to a statement released by the U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of Florida.

It said the defendants admitted they had used a variety of threats and increasingly violent acts against Ekka to force her to remain in servitude. Among other things, they confessed to burning her hand with an iron, beating her, and holding her head under water.
They also admitted taking away her passport and burning her address book and mail addressed to her in order to isolate their victim, who comes from a poor background in rural India.
Police learned of the case on Feb. 8, when Ekka dialed an emergency telephone number for help.
Sentencing was set for March 21, 1997. The couple face up to five years imprisonment, a fine of up to $250,000 and restitution.
